caption: Heat lightning flickers silently on the horizon beyond a lake on a summer night, lighting the far clouds again and again.

sa.check: A lake at night with the horizon beyond it.
Lightning flickers at the horizon, lighting the far clouds.
The flickers repeat: the far clouds light up more than once.
The flickers are distant, at the horizon rather than overhead.

pc.expect: Each flicker is brief with the clouds dark between; the flickers repeat but never merge into one steady light.
pc.fail: The far clouds stay lit for the rest of the clip; or the glow brightens steadily; or the sky turns to daylight; or a flicker fades in slowly.

pc.expect: The horizon, the far cloud bank and the shoreline are the same across lit and dark frames.
pc.fail: The clouds change shape abruptly between one flicker and the next; or the shoreline shifts; or trees or buildings on the far shore appear or vanish; or a second horizon line appears.

pc.expect: The light stays far off: the far clouds brighten while the near shore, foreground trees and anything on the water near the viewer stay dark.
pc.fail: The near shore and foreground light up as brightly as the far clouds; or the flash lights the foreground from the near side; or a bright reflection appears on the lake with no glow in the sky.

pc.expect: The lake surface moves only as slow ripples; trees and objects on the shore stay still; nothing moves at a flicker.
pc.fail: The water heaves or jumps at a flicker; or trees sway sharply at the flicker with nothing else stirring; or objects on the shore shift at the flash.

pc.expect: Land, water and cloud keep their identities: the lake stays water and the clouds stay cloud.
pc.fail: The clouds turn into solid objects; or the lake turns into solid ground; or a bolt emerges from the lake; or the far shore morphs into a different landscape.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The night colours of sky, water and shore are consistent before and after each flicker.
pc.fail: The sky changes colour permanently after a flicker; or the water changes colour; or the shore changes colour.
